newsitem.title: UK: US Stocks in London up, Intel strong.
newsitem.headline: US Stocks in London up, Intel strong.

text.p: U.S. shares trading in London were indicating a higher opening for the Dow on Wednesday with most activity seen in technology stock Intel Corp which was up almost $3 from its New York close after reporting earnings.
"The Dow may well go ahead again," said one trader. "We're looking about 20 points to the good at the start..but of course that all depends on the CPI numbers," he added.
"The main story of the day is definitely Intel, which has traded up to $84-1/4, so it's up significantly," he added.
Intel closed at $80-29/32 in New York ahead of second quarter earnings which rose to $0.92 per share from $0.59 a year ago. Analysts had been expecting earnings of around $0.90 a share.

Shares in Ascend Communications Inc, meanwhile, were trading around $53-1/8, down from a close of $53-7/8 after the company revealed worse than expected results. Second quarter earnings per share came in at $0.31 compared with First Call estimates of $0.36.
Texas Instruments was under pressure from profit-takers after the shares soared on Tuesday in response to better than expected results. The stock was trading at $109, down $3/8.
Dealers said shares in General Motors and Ford, both due to report earnings later today, were trading "nervously" on worries that the current strength of the dollar may impact on profits.
Elsewhere, the quarterly earnings season continues in earnest with Apple Computer and Kodak also scheduled to release results.

The Dow finished up 53 points at a record 7976 on Tuesday, led by technology stocks which London dealers said would probably support the market again today. The Nasdaq meanwhile, reached its ninth consecutive record.
